commands.label: validate
commands.note: This is a plugin marketplace repo for Claude Code and OpenAI Codex, not a .NET solution — the gate validates the plugins.

commands.label: manifest-parity
commands.note: Both manifests required per plugin; version/description/keywords match across the pair and the marketplace entry; the Codex skills path resolves to skills/; every skill folder's SKILL.md name matches it. claude plugin validate only warns on a version mismatch.

commands.label: skill-semantics
commands.note: Regression-pins lifecycle and workflow-neutral skill contracts; plugin validate does not check prose.

commands.label: adr-checker
commands.note: Regression-pins ADR filename, heading, and candidate-label checks.

commands.label: green-gate-runner
commands.note: Exercises the single canonical green-gate implementation.

commands.label: applicable-rules
commands.note: Proves AGENTS-aware placement preflight is read-only.

commands.label: architecture-profile
commands.note: Pins profile resolution, inheritance, suggestions, adoption, and the shipped profile library; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: profile-library
commands.note: Pins the shipped library (deltas current, Module-bundle leak check, kind-first and Module-bundle fixtures) and the scaffold templates that must agree with it; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: structural-changes
commands.note: Pins the start snapshot, the dotnet-projects detector and the structural check's statuses and exit codes; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: module-deps
commands.note: Pins the Module bundle layout tool: -Check, allowed cycles, cycle-safe deterministic output, display-only glossary descriptions, no project data.

commands.label: module-deps-hook
commands.note: Pins the opt-in PostToolUse cycle hook: returns block feedback only for a confirmed cycle in a repo with moduleDepsCheck true.

commands.label: gate-check
commands.note: Proves mechanical gate orchestration is read-only and cannot certify an unresolved target.

commands.label: instruction-governance
commands.note: Pins AGENTS.md as this repo's one instruction file: CLAUDE.md only imports it, both phase blocks resolve from it, and its skill roster equals the skill directories; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: git-commit
commands.note: Pins git-commit.ps1: a path-scoped commit whose multi-line message, embedded quote included, survives a separate Windows PowerShell process.

commands.label: integrate-feature
commands.note: Pins worktree integration: fast-forward or worktree-side merge, a conflict leaves both branches untouched, and no remote is used.

commands.label: ledger
commands.note: Pins the worktree ledger: comma-joined cleanup scopes, path normalisation without duplicate records, UTF-8 writes.

commands.label: parse-plan-tasks
commands.note: Pins plan parsing for execution and resume: task boundaries, checkbox state, nested fences.

commands.label: validate-json
commands.note: Pins validate-json.ps1 exit codes for valid, invalid and missing files.

commands.label: manifest-checker
commands.note: Proves check-plugin-manifests.ps1 fails on a missing Codex manifest, a bad Codex skills path, a skill folder/name mismatch and a version mismatch; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: primary-hooks
commands.note: Pins the primary-checkout edit/git guards and the backlog nudge for Claude Code payloads; the Codex apply_patch gap is pinned under KNOWN GAP labels until the hook input adapter lands; needs PowerShell 7 and node.

commands.label: host-parity-suite
commands.note: Fixture tests for scripts/check-host-parity.ps1: a clean parity record passes and every rule fails on its own mutation; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: host-parity
commands.note: Checks docs/host-parity.md against the skills, hook scripts, overlays and invocation metadata on disk and against the cited gate labels and smoke records; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: host-neutrality-suite
commands.note: Fixture tests for scripts/check-host-neutrality.ps1: an increase or a new file/token pair fails, a decrease asks for a lower baseline, -Update rewrites it; needs PowerShell 7.

commands.label: host-neutrality
commands.note: Agent-host-specific references in shared skill and script files may not rise above scripts/host-neutrality-baseline.json; lower it with -Update when they fall. Needs PowerShell 7.
